items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I became a part of that band...along with... Willie Shorter was the pianist

ctx.x: Leroy Smith had an orchestra, he was a violinist. And there was this, the high school band at Sydney D. Miller was formed by Matthew Rucker, and uh I became a part of that band...along with um Frank Porter, who was an alto saxophonist, Alfonso Ford, tenor saxophonist. Willie Shorter was the pianist, who later worked for Motown. Um there was a tenor player, perhaps you haven’t heard of, his name was Lorenzo Lawson, and um he was quite proficient at that time, this is the late 40’s, early 40’s, early 40’s, yeah. Um…
